contributions.name: Cédric Bernadac
contributions.summary: Runs the Z Code game workshop and directed this production: he asked for a 1980s shoot 'em up inspired by Moon Cresta, with dockable ship modules, growing bosses and lively sound effects.

contributions.name: Z Code
contributions.summary: Designed and implemented DOCKSTAR: the modular stack mechanic and its six combinations, five enemy types, four cycling boss templates, docking phases with precision bonuses, the synthesized WebAudio sound set, and the trilingual interface (EN/FR/ES) with a custom 5x7 bitmap font. v1.1: resolution-independent engine (portrait and widescreen with live switching), fullscreen with maximized fallback, and the color edition (one color family per enemy, boss palettes, moon, parallax stars).

contributions.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
contributions.summary: Reviewed the balance spreadsheet of the real playtests; its tuning suggestions (longer dart telegraph, 3 volleys for stage-1 spitters, drone fire-probability cap, boss HP frozen at stage 8, softened rage) were applied by Z Code.
